summary: Triple-field node initializer. Stores argument a2 into the node data field (this+0x0), zeroes the next-pointer field (this+0x4), stores byte flag a3 into this+0x8, and returns the node pointer. Callers across directory, collision, physics, AI and network subsystems treat it as a reusable node constructor.

operations.description: Store a2 into node data field this+0x0.
Zero next-pointer field this+0x4 (initialized to null).
Store byte flag a3 into node byte field this+0x8.

unresolved: Whether this+0x0 holds an integer value or an object pointer is not determinable from the raw source (stored as raw DWORD).
Whether the callers that reference this function do so as a C++ constructor (this in ECX) versus a plain initializer is unconfirmed.
Layout beyond this+0x8 (field 2 of the 3-field node) is not evidenced.
